## Sampler assurance registry

This generated registry records the two existing golden paths. Facets are independent: `proved` applies only to the named Lean result, while Julia paths remain test-supported unless stated otherwise.

| Sampler | Mathematics | Executable semantics | Artifact | Julia Reference | Public runtime | Optimized |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scalar Gaussian RWMH | **proved:** `gaussianRandomWalkMetropolisHastings_invariant` — Markov, reversibility, and invariance theorems are checked. | **proved:** `gaussianRwmhProgramKernel_refines` — Exact kernel equality and deterministic trace replay are checked. | **generated/checkable:** `gaussian_rwmh_step!` — Lean emits the canonical declaration; regeneration is checked. | **tested:** `Reference.gaussian_rwmh_step!` — Julia parsing, replay, and validation are test-supported. | **tested:** `GaussianRWMH` — Seeded API and statistical regressions exercise Reference. | **tested:** `Optimized.gaussian_rwmh_step!` — The independent implementation has deterministic differential tests. |
| Scalar fixed-step endpoint HMC | **proved:** `endpointHmcNPositionKernel_invariant` — The refreshed/projected exact endpoint kernel preserves its target under the stated factorization. | **documented boundary:** `runScalarHmc_refines` — Trace replay and integrator correspondence are proved; no single theorem equates the full command kernel to the position kernel. | **generated/checkable:** `scalar_hmc_step!` — Lean emits the canonical declaration; regeneration is checked. | **tested:** `Reference.scalar_hmc_step!` — Julia parsing, replay, callbacks, and validation are test-supported. | **tested:** `ScalarHMC` — Seeded API and moment regressions exercise Reference. | **tested:** `Optimized.scalar_hmc_step!` — The independent implementation has deterministic differential tests. |
